[[File:Anthony EP029.png|250px|thumb|Anthony]] '''Anthony''' (Japanese: '''アノキ''' ''Anoki'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP029|The Punchy Pokémon]]''. He operates the {{DL|Gym|Fighting Spirit Gym}}, an elite facility for {{type|Fighting}} Pokémon. Anthony was {{pkmn|training}} his {{p|Hitmonchan}} to compete in the upcoming [[P1 Grand Prix]]. He was so determined to train and win, that he was neglecting his family. His daughter, {{OBP|Rebecca|EP029}}'s feelings convinced {{Ash}} and {{an|Brock}} to compete in the P1 Grand Prix to defeat him. Ash entered using his {{AP|Primeape}}. Anthony noticed early on that the Pig Monkey Pokémon was very strong. Anthony ended up losing in the semi-finals to {{TRT}} and the {{p|Hitmonlee}} they had stolen from {{OBP|Giant|EP029}}, another competitor. Eventually, Ash defeated Hitmonlee in the finals and won the P1 Grand Prix. Afterwards, Anthony offered to train Primeape further, and Ash agreed. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} This listing is of Anthony's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: ===On hand=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Anthony |pkmn=Hitmonchan |gender=male |type1=Fighting |epnum=EP029 |epname=The Punchy Pokémon |vajp= |vaen=Michael Haigney |img=Anthony Hitmonchan.png |desc= When {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} first saw Anthony's {{p|Hitmonchan}}, they thought he was a [[wild Pokémon]], prompting Ash to want to {{pkmn2|caught|catch him}}. He taught {{AP|Pikachu}} a boxing move called the "Rocket Punch", though it didn't have much of an effect and he lost when Anthony gave Hitmonchan instructions. In the [[P1 Grand Prix]], Hitmonchan defeated a {{p|Machamp}} before being defeated in the semi-finals by {{OBP|Giant|EP029}}'s {{p|Hitmonlee}} under [[Jessie]]'s ownership when his foot got stuck in glue {{MTR}} put on the stage.
